# A document somebody put markup in

<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>

An inline <script>alert(1)</script> in a paragraph, an <img src=x onerror=alert(1)>,
and an <iframe src="https://example.org"></iframe>.

<div onclick="alert(1)">A raw HTML block.</div>

A link that runs script: [click me](javascript:alert(1)).
